description: Source code for a Windows Media Foundation audio encoder implementation within Chromium, handling AAC encoding, media type setup, buffer management, and encoding process control.

classes.name: MFAudioEncoder
classes.description: Implements an AAC audio encoder using Windows Media Foundation, managing media types, buffers, encoding process, and state transitions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the encoder with specified options, creates media types, and prepares buffer requirements.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a given AudioBus with associated capture time, queuing data if necessary.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the encoder, processing remaining data and signaling end of stream.

methods.name: EnqueueInput
methods.description: Converts AudioBus to media sample, queues for processing.

methods.name: TryProcessInput
methods.description: Processes queued input samples, manages state transitions.

methods.name: TryProcessOutput
methods.description: Retrieves encoded output, manages draining and state.

methods.name: ProcessOutput
methods.description: Retrieves encoded data from the encoder, copies to buffer, and creates output buffer.

methods.name: OnFlushComplete
methods.description: Completes flushing, resets state, and processes pending inputs.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles error state, fails all queued operations.
